site.title: Tallis Contact | Customer care and back-office teams in Manila
site.description: Tallis Contact runs customer care, back-office processing and technical support teams from Manila and Cebu for retail, travel and software companies.

data.title: Customer care teams for *retail, travel and software*
data.lead: Tallis Contact answers calls, chats and emails for 40 brands from Manila and Cebu, with a team lead and a quality analyst on every account.
